facts.text: At first it was only when I exerted myself, then it got worse, and now I'm short of breath even at rest.
It started about a week ago.
I haven't taken any medicines recently.
I don't have any risk factors for heart disease.
I've never had a connective tissue disease.

gold.reasoning: 1. Myocardial infarction was considered but excluded — “The presence of global left ventricular dysfunction was better explained with myocarditis than myocardial infarction as there should be multi territory ischaemia to explain it which was less likely in our patient given that she was young and did not had any cardiovascular risk factors.” 2. Drug-induced hypersensitivity reaction was considered but ruled out — “Drug hypersensitivity as a cause of eosinophilia was excluded from history.” 3. Parasitic infestation was considered but excluded — “Both serum IgM and IgG were negative for Filaria, Toxoplasma and toxocara infection and stool examination was negative for parasites.” 4. Common viral and other infections were considered but excluded — “Serology for Epstein-Barr virus, Cytomegalo virus and Mycoplasma were negative. Retroviral infection and tuberculosis were excluded. Her blood culture and autoimmune screen were negative.” 5. Other secondary causes including connective tissue disease were considered but excluded — “Normal thyroid function test, negative ANA, DsDNA, negative antibody tires of common viral infection were used to exclude other differential diagnosis.”

source_issues: s002 says she denied 'systemic symptoms', which contradicts the low-grade fever, malaise and profuse sweating in s001; that phrase is not written as a fact.
Troponin I is given in ng/dL (normal <1.0); troponin is usually reported in ng/mL. Kept as written.
The leukocyte total is not given, though the eosinophil count of 21.6×10^3/μL at 63.5% implies about 34×10^3/μL.
notes: Index visit: the admission after one week of progressive dyspnea with low-grade fever, malaise and profuse sweating (s001-s003); the examination and all tests (s004-s017) belong to this admission workup.
s018: endomyocardial biopsy was declined and coronary angiography was not performed; no results, so no findings.
The 'dyspneic at rest' examination finding (s005) also supports the course fact f002; it stays in the general-appearance finding.
